description: Create app-store screenshots, social graphics, promo videos, and animated device mockups from your app screenshots. Browse your projects and uploaded assets, upload new assets, compare personalized screenshot and social styles, and preview three promo-video concepts. Interactive pickers appear in supported clients, with browser links as a fallback. You choose a style before a variant is created. Edit the results in your connected AppLaunchFlow account.

defaultPrompt: Create a fresh App Store screenshot variant for my latest project and let me choose from personalized styles.
Generate social graphics for my latest project, let me pick a style, and update the Instagram Story headline.
Create three promo-video concepts from my current iPhone screenshots and open the picker.
